Vice-Tay

 [!IMPORTANT]
 Development Paused Until Monday, November 30 (AI Usage Limit Reached) 
 
 Active development on Vice-Tay is taking a brief pit stop until Monday, November 30 : the AI copilot behind our workflow has reached its usage limit for the current cycle, and we are waiting for the quota to recharge before jumping back into the codebase.
 
 Nothing is expected or required. Development will resume as soon as the limit is available again. If you would like to optionally help accelerate development and get us back to work earlier, voluntary donations go directly toward extra AI credits so we can return ahead of schedule; otherwise, the project will stay paused until Monday.
 
 Ethereum (USDC): 0x813E922837A7508d9A6838F171C63463f31A4717 

 Xbox Series compatibility on Windows, tuned on a GeForce RTX 4090. 

Vice-Tay builds on VIctory to run an Xbox Series title from your own files. The title's x86-64 code runs on the host CPU. The compatibility layer provides the console APIs it calls and translates its graphics work to Direct3D 12.

Quick start · Measurements · Measurements on GitHub Pages

 Measurements

The goal is 30 rendered FPS in the open world with correct visuals .

 Series S boat test at 4K

On November 27, 2026, I repeated the same boat route with two local builds. Both used DLSS Quality (2560 × 1440 → 3840 × 2160) and AMD 2× frame generation. Each result averages about 39 seconds of telemetry.

 Build Rendered FPS Generated FPS Presented FPS 
 --- ---: ---: ---: 
 4K reference · e9a30f4f 16.12 16.12 32.25 
 4K experimental · 424fb3f6 26.72 26.72 53.44 

The experimental build reached a median of 27.80 rendered FPS across the sampled intervals. The Series S 4K option is under review in PR 329.

4K settings, frame counts and percentiles

 Earlier Series S measurements

 Session Result 
 --- --- 
 1080p GPU read-through test An on/off test with the boat stationary went from 22.60 to 26.38 rendered FPS and 45.13 to 52.78 presented FPS . 
 6-minute frame generation test · 88e80129 Medians of 22.4 rendered FPS and 44.9 presented FPS in a separate 1080p test with 2× frame generation. 
 30-minute playtest · bc090416 Median of 21.1 rendered FPS and a 17.0 FPS 1% low across the prologue, the boat section and traversal on foot. 

1080p comparison · Frame generation test · 30-minute playtest

 Test PC · RTX 4090 (24 GB), Ryzen 9 9950X3D, 48 GiB DDR5, Windows 11 Pro x64

 
 Full test configuration 

 Component Configuration 
 --- --- 
 CPU and motherboard AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D (16 cores, 32 threads), MSI MAG X870 TOMAHAWK WIFI (MS-7E51), BIOS 1.A93 
 Graphics NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24 GB GDDR6X, driver 621.40), integrated AMD Radeon Graphics 
 Memory 2 × 24 GiB DDR5 at 8,000 MT/s, 43.4 GiB visible to Windows, 128 GiB page file 
 Storage Samsung 990 PRO 4 TB and 2 TB, Samsung 970 PRO 1 TB 
 Display Samsung Odyssey OLED G8 (G81SF), 3840 × 2160 at 240 Hz 
 OS Windows 11 Pro 26H2 x64, build 26300.10075 

 

In the 30-minute playtest, checkpoint retries worked after the boat ran aground. The HUD, minimap, mission prompts and pause menu were usable along the route.

 Getting started

 Requirements. Windows 10 or 11 x64, an AVX2-capable CPU, a Direct3D 12 GPU with Shader Model 6.6 and mesh shader support, Rust, and MSVC build tools with a Windows SDK. Rust uses the version pinned in rust-toolchain.toml .

 [!IMPORTANT]
 Bring your own copy of the title. Keep the executable, game data and derived cache outside this checkout. See the asset policy.
 The runtime reports unverified game and package licences as inactive. A title that requires a verified licence may stop at startup.

1. Clone the repository and copy the configuration template.

 

2. Set game dir in victory.toml to the directory containing your title files. Build the diagnostics executable and launch the Series S profile with the path to your executable.

 

Use Play-VIctory.cmd to pass the same options from Command Prompt. Double-click it to enter the executable's path at a prompt. The launcher defaults to full screen, the Series X profile and an automatic GPU preset. F11 or Alt+Enter toggles full screen during play.

For titles that use BCPack, set VICTORY BCPACK TABLES to the path of a local copy of the format tables you are authorised to use.

If the title reaches the menu but stops at world load, verify your title files before changing graphics settings. Compare the full file hashes against a trusted manifest for the exact release you own, using the algorithm listed in that manifest. An archive with missing or zero-filled data can still have the expected size. Re-copy any mismatched files from your verified source and check the hashes again before launching.

 Option Use it to 
 --- --- 
 -Console series-s Select the lighter console profile used in the sessions above. 
 -Machine 4090 / -Machine 4070 / -Machine 7900xtx Select a GPU preset explicitly. See the RTX 4070 test notes. 
 -Machine 4070tisuper The RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (16 GB) preset, asked for explicitly. With Resizable BAR on, it moves up to 4 GB of shader-read windows from RAM into the card's memory. Also measured on an RTX 5080 with eight cores, where it ran one scene at 27 fps against 16 with the RTX 4090 settings. 
 -Machine laptop Try the 16 GB NVIDIA laptop preset, measured on one RTX 3050 laptop. 
 -Machine 3060 Try the six-core, 16 GB NVIDIA desktop preset, measured on one RTX 3060 12 GB / i5-12400F PC. 
 -Safe Launch with the conservative settings when investigating a graphics or stability issue. 
 -Windowed / -NoPanel Start in a window or hide the diagnostics overlay at launch. 
 -RayTracing Enable the structures needed for the title's ray-traced indirect lighting. 
 -Fsr4K quality / -Dlss4K quality Upscale to 3840 × 2160 with PC FSR or DLSS on Series X. 
 -FrameIntervalMs 16.67 Set the frame interval in milliseconds. Use 0 to remove the limit or omit the option to keep the title's setting. 
 -WarmPipelines Warm pipelines used in previous runs before star

install.title: Getting started
install.html:
Requirements. Windows 10 or 11 x64, an AVX2-capable CPU, a Direct3D 12 GPU with Shader Model 6.6 and mesh shader support, Rust, and MSVC build tools with a Windows SDK. Rust uses the version pinned in rust-toolchain.toml.

[!IMPORTANT] Bring your own copy of the title. Keep the executable, game data and derived cache outside this checkout. See the asset policy. The runtime reports unverified game and package licences as inactive. A title that requires a verified licence may stop at startup.

  1. Clone the repository and copy the configuration template.

    git clone https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay.git
Set-Location Vice-Tay
Copy-Item .\victory.example.toml .\victory.toml

  2. Set game_dir in victory.toml to the directory containing your title files. Build the diagnostics executable and launch the Series S profile with the path to your executable.

    cargo build --locked --profile diag -p victory --features diagnostics
.\scripts\play.ps1 -Exe 'D:\victory-data\game\game.exe' -Console series-s

Use Play-VIctory.cmd to pass the same options from Command Prompt. Double-click it to enter the executable's path at a prompt. The launcher defaults to full screen, the Series X profile and an automatic GPU preset. F11 or Alt+Enter toggles full screen during play.

For titles that use BCPack, set VICTORY_BCPACK_TABLES to the path of a local copy of the format tables you are authorised to use.

If the title reaches the menu but stops at world load, verify your title files before changing graphics settings. Compare the full file hashes against a trusted manifest for the exact release you own, using the algorithm listed in that manifest. An archive with missing or zero-filled data can still have the expected size. Re-copy any mismatched files from your verified source and check the hashes again before launching.

Option Use it to
-Console series-s Select the lighter console profile used in the sessions above.
-Machine 4090 / -Machine 4070 / -Machine 7900xtx Select a GPU preset explicitly. See the RTX 4070 test notes.
-Machine 4070tisuper The RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (16 GB) preset, asked for explicitly. With Resizable BAR on, it moves up to 4 GB of shader-read windows from RAM into the card's memory. Also measured on an RTX 5080 with eight cores, where it ran one scene at 27 fps against 16 with the RTX 4090 settings.
-Machine laptop Try the 16 GB NVIDIA laptop preset, measured on one RTX 3050 laptop.
-Machine 3060 Try the six-core, 16 GB NVIDIA desktop preset, measured on one RTX 3060 12 GB / i5-12400F PC.
-Safe Launch with the conservative settings when investigating a graphics or stability issue.
-Windowed / -NoPanel Start in a window or hide the diagnostics overlay at launch.
-RayTracing Enable the structures needed for the title's ray-traced indirect lighting.
-Fsr4K quality / -Dlss4K quality Upscale to 3840 × 2160 with PC FSR or DLSS on Series X.
-FrameIntervalMs 16.67 Set the frame interval in milliseconds. Use 0 to remove the limit or omit the option to keep the title's setting.
-WarmPipelines Warm pipelines used in previous runs before starting the title.
-Build release Use the executable built with cargo build --locked --release -p victory. The overlay requires a diagnostics build.
PC upscaling and Series S frame generation

The Series X 4K profiles support quality, balanced and performance on build 1.0.2.1. They render at 2560 × 1440, 2258 × 1270 and 1920 × 1080 respectively. For Series S, use -Dlss or -Fsr with the same three presets to keep the console profile's output size. These presets set the render scale, including when used with -Machine laptop.

For FSR, point VICTORY_FIDELITYFX_DIR or [paths].fidelityfx_dir at the folder containing amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll. The 4K mode prefers FSR 4.1.2 and uses 3.1.6 when that is what the adapter supports. In Series S, pass -More @{VICTORY_FSR4_SERIES_S='1'} to prefer FSR 4.1.2 on a supported adapter. Series S uses FSR 3.1.6 by default. Both profiles can use FSR when DLSS fails. For DLSS on an RTX card, get nvngx_dlss.dll from the NVIDIA DLSS SDK. Set VICTORY_DLSS_DIR or [paths].dlss_dir to its folder, or put the DLL beside victory.exe. Some drivers ship without this library. Vice-Tay checks for it before initializing NGX and uses the configured FSR fallback when it is missing. VICTORY_DLSS_NO_UPDATE=1 uses the installed selection without an NGX update. AMD FSR SDK · NVIDIA DLSS SDK

For 2× Series S frame generation, pass -FrameGen. Point VICTORY_FFX_FG_DIR or [paths].ffx_fg_dir at the SDK 2.4.0 Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin folder with amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll and amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_dx12.dll. If neither is set, the FSR upscaler folder is used. This uses AMD's analytical 3.1.6 frame generation provider. The launch below uses DLSS on an RTX card.

$env:VICTORY_FFX_FG_DIR = '<SDK signedbin>'
.\scripts\play.ps1 -Exe 'D:\victory-data\game\game.exe' -Console series-s -Dlss quality -FrameGen

With neither PC upscaler selected, frame generation uses depth and motion vectors from the title's native FidelityFX loader. RENDER FPS in the diagnostics panel counts rendered frames, and FG OUTPUT FPS counts swap-chain presentations. The PC FSR bridge follows DexNom's implementation through beloooo's port. The frame generation bridge follows PastiiJay's DirectX 12 integration.

Shader cache and pipeline warm-up

The launcher pretranslates shaders when it has no completed scan for the current shader cache key and source paths. On Windows it uses game_dir when configured and falls back to the executable's directory. The driver may still build pipelines during the first run.

Run these steps separately from the repository root to warm the shader cache and compile pipelines seen in previous runs. Both steps can resume from cached work.

.\target\diag\victory.exe shaders
.\target\diag\victory.exe warm --used

Pass an archive path to shaders to scan just that archive. At launch, --if-needed checks file metadata throughout each input directory before reusing a completed scan. On Windows volumes that do not report file change times, it scans the input again. -SkipShaders skips pretranslation at launch. -WarmPipelines runs the same warm --used command after pretranslation. When comparing warm-up times, warm --used --batch-size 80 tests longer batches and warm --used --normal-priority tests normal worker priority. Change one option at a time. The defaults are 40 pipelines per worker process and idle priority.

The opening's head blend-shape map starts compiling when its pipeline is created. Its dispatch can wait up to two seconds for the result. After a timeout, later dispatches use the pipeline as soon as it is ready. Set VICTORY_HEAD_MAP_WAIT=0 for the ordinary pipeline schedule and wait budget.

Direct3D 12 Agility SDK on Windows 10

For a Windows runtime that rejects root signature flags c00 or c01, use the application-local Microsoft.Direct3D.D3D12 1.620.2 package.

  1. Open the .nupkg as a ZIP and copy build/native/bin/x64/D3D12Core.dll to target\diag\D3D12\. The optional debug layer uses D3D12SDKLayers.dll from the same package.

  2. Build with the Agility SDK exports enabled.

    $env:VICTORY_AGILITY_SDK = '1'
try { cargo build --locked --profile diag -p victory --features diagnostics }
finally { Remove-Item Env:VICTORY_AGILITY_SDK }

  3. Launch with scripts\play.ps1. Keep the D3D12 folder beside the executable. For a release build, use target\release\D3D12\ and build with --release.

Linux and Proton: a faster wineserver

Under Proton the title keeps 90,000 to 136,000 mapped views alive and maps or unmaps about a thousand a second. Stock wineserver keeps a process's views in a list and searches it from the front on every request, so everything that waits on the server slows down. linux/wineserver builds GE-Proton11-14's wineserver with a red-black tree of views and puts it in a copy of the GE-Proton folder, GE-Proton11-14-viewtree.
